releaseNotes:
- Added version channel separation (-t trial, -rev review, -offi official)
- Added channel risk tags and user recommendation guidance
- Added interactive 'What's New' feature onboarding flow with skip/back navigation
newFeatures: Version Channel Separation: Instant awareness of -t (Trial), -rev (Review), and -offi (Official) updates.
Smart Safety Recommendations: Clear risk badges helping you decide whether to install or wait.
Interactive Feature Setup: Step-by-step 'What's New' walkthrough after updating, with skip and swipe options.
